messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "take liquid medicine on an empty stomach at least 1 hour before a meal or 2 hours after a meal"
set: ["take liquid medicine on an empty stomach at least 1 hour before a meal or 2 hours after a meal", "take after a meal", "take with a meal or immediately after a meal", "take after a meal or a snack", "take on an empty stomach", "take at least 2 hours after an antacid", "take with food or just after a meal", "take shortly after a meal or light snack", "take other medications at least 2 hours before or after", "take oral suspension on an empty stomach", "take on empty stomach at least 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast", "take 2 hours before or after sucralfate", "take a single dose at least 2 hours before exercise for exercise-induced bronchoconstriction", "taken about half an hour after the same meal each day", "take at least 8 hours before aspirin", "take at least 4 hours before resin"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
